verdict.rationale: Firebase's Firestore/Realtime Database are schemaless NoSQL stores with no documented migration tooling; the evidence pack shows CLI deployment of rules, indexes, and functions but nothing resembling version-controlled schema migrations. Community commentary explicitly flags this as a pain point, noting Firebase's lack of a business-logic layer 'makes schema changes extremely challenging for deployed mobile clients' (firebase-comm-15), confirming the gap rather than filling it.
